note: Invented village post office room on Namestie sv. Rozalie, June 1960 (type reference: the 1956 Budapest post office counter). Customer side on the left: the glazed entrance door, the 1960 wall calendar, the window to the square. On the right the counter runs to the right edge (top edge y 627, front foot y 820) under a glazed wooden partition; the clerk stands at its open sliding service window (bust cut at the counter top). The walk polygon is the customer floor in front of the counter, with the area in front of the door, calendar and window.
